sources.snippet: What it does killinchu is the counter-UAS edge tool of the SZL drones & vessels product. It runs where the mission happens — detecting, classifying, and evaluating hostile UAS tracks at machine speed, signing every interdiction decision with a DSSE Khipu receipt, and surfacing the result to a human operator before any action propagates.
